acceptance: A test shows a grant line with no prefix is counted.
fix: Build both regexes from one shared prefix constant.
summary: readReportLine accepts a line with no name(pid) prefix, and grantReportLine still requires one. If macOS emits a grant read with no prefix, recordContextAccess does not count the entry, and it can emit a false CodeContextRequiredUnopened Info signal. No evidence that such a line occurs on real macOS output.
title: The read report and grant report regexes disagree on the process prefix
